gamesDealTracker.description: Discord bot that tracks video game deals. It is deployed on PebbleHost. Next step: Epic Games Store support.

priceAlertBot.name: TODO(elian): Price Alert Bot
priceAlertBot.description: Personal-use Telegram bot that sends price alerts from Chilean stores such as Falabella, Ripley, Paris, MercadoLibre and PCFactory. It uses SerpAPI and store URL tracking.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I live in Chile and trained in Informatics Engineering at Universidad de La Frontera. I have under two years of professional experience, split between internships and a short period of formal employment.
about.p2: I mostly work with Python, JavaScript and databases. I like building tools that solve concrete problems, like the bots in this portfolio.
about.p3: Outside of code I shoot landscape photography. The gallery on this page is a selection.
about.p4: I am looking for junior opportunities in Full Stack development, web development and data engineering.
